about: Foods for the calorie estimate (nutrition.py). Values are per 100 g as sold/used raw unless the name says cooked/canned, mostly from USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy and Foundation Foods (public domain); a few Australian items (haloumi, kangaroo, AU bacon, thickened cream, fresh noodles, gnocchi, pastes and sauces) are rounded label/FSANZ AUSNUT-style averages and marked approx in the note field. Names match whole words, plurals included, longest name first; aka lists other names. each = grams for one item; sizes = grams for small/medium/large; units = grams for a piece word such as clove, slice, can, bunch; cup = grams per US cup, only for foods static/unit-ingredients.json does not already cover (that file wins); density = grams per ml for liquids; drained = share of a can's net weight left after draining; cooked/canned/dried/skin_on = the food to use when the line says so; negligible = recognised but too small to matter (salt, spices, water, herbs) and left out of the coverage count.
